693)༄༅/nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te srid zhi gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas

tei:div.tei:p: 693) ༄༅/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te srid zhi gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa theg chen spyi'i sems bskyed yin/ rgyud las/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ zhes gsungs te/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ye gzod ma nyid nas ngo bo ye dag rang bzhin rnam dag gzhi lhun grub kyis sangs rgyas yin kyang*/ glo bur gyi sgrib pa sprin dang 'dra bas bsgribs te/ sangs rgyas go ma chod pa rnams/ rang gnas kyi ye shes/ rang bzhag gi chos sku/ rang rig zung 'jug 'gyur ba med pa'i dbyings su bsgral bar bgyi'o snyam pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sems ye shes su bskyed pa yin no/ sems bskyed de dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gang nyams su blang bar bya ba theg pa thams cad kyi rtse rgyal/ man ngag thams cad kyi rgyal po/ rtsol med 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba la/ 694)rtsol med zhes pa ni/ a nu man chad kyi rtsol bcas kyi theg pa brgyad pos/ mnyam bzhag tu ye shes re gtan la dbab rgyu yod kyang*/ rjes thob tu rnam rtog gi dkrug dkrug pas/ lam rtsol bcas su song ba yin/ rdzogs pa chen pos mnyam bzhag tu ye shes gtan la dbab/ rjes thob tu ye shes kho na rang ngo skyong bas rnam rtog gi dkrug mi dgos pas na/ rnam rtog re dogs kyi rtsol ba med pas rtsol med zhes bya ba yin/ spyir rdzogs pa chen po la/ rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi yod/ de bsdu na/ sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum ste/ yid can rnams la sems kyi sde/ zhes snang ba thams cad sems tsam du gtan la dbab/

sems nyid kun byed rgyal po zhes 'dod pas sems sde spang bya'i mtha' las ma grol/ nam mkha' can la klong gi sde/ zhes snang ba thams cad sems su gtan la dbab/ sems stong nyid du gtan la phab/ stong pa stong rkyang de la dbyings kun tu bzang mo zhes 'dod pas/ klong sde gnyan po'i mtha' las ma grol/ man ngag gi sde gnad thog gi me btsa' lta bu yin/ man ngag gi sde de la rgyud kyi dbang du btang na/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i rgyud bcu bdun/ sngags srung khros ma'i rgyud 695)dang bco brgyad/ de dag gi dgongs nyams gcig tu dril ba kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams kyi rgyas pa'i bstan bcos klong chen mdzod bdun ni/ yid bzhin mdzod/ grub mtha' mdzod/ theg mchog mdzod/ gnas lugs mdzod/ chos dbyings mdzod/ 'od gsal mdzod/ man ngag mdzod dang bdun/ zab pa'i bstan bcos snying thig ya bzhi ni/ bī ma'i gsang ba snying thig pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro snying thig ste/ ma gnyis/ bu bla ma yang tig dang mkha' 'gro yang tig gnyis/ de gnyis ka'i yang tig zab mo yang tig bcas pa rnams yin/ de thams cad kyi nyams len man ngag gnad du bsdus pa rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal bso/ sgyu ma ngal bso/ bsam gtan ngal bso te ngal bso skor gsum yin/ de dag gi dgongs nyams gcig tu dril ba ni/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le ste/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa la/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams kyis lan gsum du zhal bstan/ brjod bya don gyi brgyud pa gtad/ rjod byed tshig gi brgyud pa rtogs par mdzad nas 696)da lta'i/ dus na 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i don man ngag dmar khrid kyi sgo nas nyams su len rgyu yod pa ni/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling ba kho na'i bka' drin ma gtogs/

gzhan su yang drin mi che bas/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le zhes bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig 'phrad chog thos pa rang grol/ 'brel tshad gdod ma'i dbyings su skyel ba'i zab lam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di nyid kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa la/ thun mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro/ bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim/ 'brel tshad gdod ma'i dbyings su skyel ba'i zab lam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di nyid kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa la/ thun mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro/ bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim/ gsang dbang gi lam rang lus thabs ldan/ sher dbang gi lam gzhan lus phyag rgya'i khrid rnams sngon du song nas/ dbang bzhi'i lam zab lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po la/ ༈ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po/ lam rdzogs pa chen po/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po dang gsum las/ ༈ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po ni/ sems can rnams kyi sems kyi babs/ gshis/ ngo bo/ yin lugs/ 'dug tshul rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ ye gzod ma nyid nas ngo bo ye dag gi sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas/ gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas/ stobs sogs yon tan rgya mtsho/ ma brtsal ye rdzogs rang chas su 697)su yod pa ngo bo stong pa'i cha ni nam mkha' lta bu/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i cha ni nyi ma ltar yon tan ye rdzogs su yod kyang gshis la gos ma myong ba'i glo bur gyi dri ma sprin dang 'dra bas bsgribs ste/ sangs rgyas yin kyang yin go ma chod pa ni/ he badz+ra las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas dngos/ zhes dang*/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed cing*/ 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ zhes gsungs pa ni/ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po yin/ ༈ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po ni/

lam nyams su blang bar bya ba glo bur dri ma 'bral rung du yod pa sgrib pa/ mthar thug gi shes bya'i sgrib pa glo bur rnam rtog breng breng po 'di nyid rang dag rang yal rang sangs/ wal po rjes med du dag nas ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul yin lugs rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du gyur na 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po yin/ ༈ da ni lam rdzogs pa chen po la smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis las/ smin byed dbang la sngags gong ma'i dbang bzhi pa las nang gses spros bcas 698)spros med shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med de dbang bzhir dbye ba'i snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang thob dgos la/ de yang mi nus na/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i rtsa dbang rgyal thabs spyi blugs tsam thob nas/ dbang srog rgyud la 'dzin pa dam tshig ni/ spyi yi dam tshig so thar gyi nyis brgya lnga bcu nga gsum/ byang sems kyi zab mo lta srol gyi rtsa ltung bco brgyad/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya gnyis dang nyi shu/ yan lag gi nyes byas brgyad cu/ rgya chen spyod srol gyi kun slong bzhi/ sbyor ba brgyad/ yan lag gi nyes byas zhe drug gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i thog ma'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga/ thun mong phyi nang gi rigs lnga'i sdom pa/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad/ rdzogs pa chen po'i srung du yod pa rim gyis pa'i dam chig rtsa ba bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la dgud gur dbye ba nyi shu rtsa bdun/ bsrung du med pa cig char ba'i dam tshig med pa/ phyal ba/ gcig pu/ lhun grub rnams dang*/ rgyas par dbye na dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sder dbye ba yod kyang*/ man ngag gi lugs la lus kyi sgo nas/ srog bcad/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ ngag gi sgo nas rdzun/ 699)phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/ yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems/ gnod sems/

log lta ste/ mi dge ba bcu po cha dang bcas pa spang ba la so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dam tshig thams cad 'dus pas mi dge ba bcu po cha dang bcas pa srog la bab kyang mi spyod pa ni dam tshig rnam par dag pa yin/ dbang thob dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ grol byed kyi gdams pa nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ le lo can 'bad med du grol ba ka dag khreg chod dang*/ brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas su grol ba lhun grub thod rgal gnyis las/ lhun grub thod rgal ni/ lus ngag gi bya ba dgu phrugs su btang nas/ lus bzhugs stangs gsum las mi 'gul/ mig gzigs stangs gsum las mi g.yo bar nyams su len dgos pas dka' la/ ka dag khregs chod 'di ni 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du nyams su len lo bas le lo can 'bad med grol ba'i ka dag khregs chod zer ba yin pas/ 'dir ka dag khregs chod kyi khrid mo che de nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ ༈ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu rdib pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprod pa/ 670)rjes nyams kyi skyong tshul bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po gnyis go bde bar byas na/ sems rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ thun mong byung gnas 'gro gsum btag pa/ thun mong ma yin pa yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags te gnas lugs 'od gsal chen po gtan la dbab pa dang bzhi las/ ༈ dang po sems rtsad bcad pa la/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin par rigs pas sgrub pa ni/ mar 'khor ba las 'khyams 'dod 'khor ba'i bya ba chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis kun nas bslang*/ sbyor ba mi dge ba bcu sgrub/ 'bras bu ngan song gsum du skye bar byed na yang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs yin/ yar dge ba'i lam la zhugs te/ skyes bu chung ngus bsam pa rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'i yang dag pa'i lta bas kun nas bslang*/ sbyor ba bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum ni/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/

tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ mi g.yo ba las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum sgrub/ 'bras bu mngon mtho lha dang mi yi go 'phang sgrub na yang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs yin/ skyes bu 'bring 701)gi lam/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas bslang*/ lam lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ bslab pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum sgrub/ 'bras bu nyan rang gi go 'phang sgrub na yang sems gtso bo lus ngag gnyis grogs yin/ skyes bu chen po'i lam/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ste/ zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs/ zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i sgo nas/ 'bras bu la dam bca' ba smon sems/ rgyu la dam bca' ba 'jug sems ste/ smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ lam pha rol du phyin pa drug ste/ shes rab kyis srid mtha' mnan/ snying rjes zhi mtha' mnan te mtha' gnyis las 'das pa sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu pha rol du phyin pa/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab ste phar phyin drug sgrub/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi 702)go 'phang sgrub na yang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag nyis grogs yin/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rim la brten nas/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub/ rdzogs rim la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub sgrub na'ang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs yin/ de ni gsar rnying thun mong gi lugs dang*/ sngags rnying ma'i dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen po'i lta ba gtan la phab/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la brten nas mchog thun dngos grub gcig char sgrub na yang sems gtso bo lus ngag gnyis grogs yin/

mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bya ba gang dang gang sgrub la 'jug kyang gtso bo sems/ lus ngag gnyis grogs byed pa ma gtogs/ lus ngag gtso bo sems grogs byed nas sgrub mi lo bas/ de ni sems tso che bar rig pas sgrub pa yin/ gnyis pa lung gis sgrub pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ yid gtso yid ni rab tu mgyogs pa ste// chos rnams kun gyi sna la de 'gro'o/ zhes dang*/ dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos// de kun rang gi sems las byung*/ zhes gsungs 703)pas rgyal ba'i bka' las kyang sems gtso che bar gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ khyod kyi thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis// sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ zhes sogs rjes 'jug 'khas pa'i bstan bcos rnams las kyang*/ sems gtso che gsungs pa ma gtogs sems gtso mi che gsungs pa'i lung btsal kyang snyed du med pas/ de ni sems gtso che bar lung gis sgrub pa yin/ des sems rtsad bcad pa song la/ ༈ gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba ni/ mtshangs btsal ba gang la btsal na/ lus ngag yid gsum steng nas btsal dgos/ de yang spyir lus zhes 'bral zhing shul du lus pas lus te/ 'dod khams mi rnams kyis lus 'di 'chi ba'i tshe shul du lus pas na lus zhes zer/ lha rnams lus nyi tshan du mar gong bzhag pa bzhin 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas zhu ba las shul du lus pa med kyang lus dang sems 'bral du yod pas lus ces bya/ ༈ ngag ni lus kyi nang na rtsa thams cad yi ge 'khor lo'i tshul du yod pas yid brjod 'dod kyi 704)rtog pas rlung g.yo bas/ rtsa yi ge 'khor lo'i rang sgra grags pas ngag sems yid rnam rtog rnam shes rnams don gcig la ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ yul la sems pas na sems/ yul yid la byed pas na yid/ yul gyi rnam pa rtog dpyod byed pas rnam rtog yul gyi rnam pa shes pas rnam shes ces bya'o/

lus ngag yid gsum po de'i steng na skyon nam mtshang ci zhig yod snyam na/ sems can rnams kyi res 'ga' lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu 'dzin te nga zhes brjod/ res 'ga' tha dad du bzung nas nga yi mgo nga yi lag pa/ nga yi rkang pa/ nga yi lus/ nga'i ngag nga'i sems zhes brjod/ yang na gcig yang na tha dad yin dgos ma gtogs gcig tha dad gnyis ka yin par shes bya la mi srid pas/ des na mtshang bsal dgos te/ gcig yin nam snyam na/ min te/ lus ngag mthong thos rung ba bzhin sems mthong rung ba dang*/ sems mthong thos mi rung ba bzhin du lus ngag mthong thos mi rung ba'i skyon khas len dgos pas gcig ma yin no/ ༈ 'o na tha dad yin snyam na/ tha dad yin na rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang gi tha dad dang*/ mi rtag 705)du ma gzhan dbang gi tha dad gnyis ma gtogs yod mi srid la/ lus rtag pa yin nam snyam na min te/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa dang*/ phra ba skad gcig gi mi rtag pa gnyis yod/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa ni/ lus 'di nyid dang po skyes nas byis pa dar ma rgan pa sogs lo zla ba zhag za ma sogs rim gyis 'gyur nas 'gro ba 'di rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa yin/ phra ba skad cig gi mi rtag pa ni/ se gol gcig gtogs pa'i yun la cha drug cu re bzhir dbye ba'i cha re re bzhin nas mi rtag par 'gro ba chu bo'i rgyun lta bu yin/ des ni lus rtag pa ma yin mi rtag pa yin/ gcig pu ma yin tha dad pa yin te/ lus 'di la/ rus dum sum brgya drug cu skra nyi khri chig stong drug brgya sogs/ rdul phran du ma bsags pa yin pas gcig ma yin du ma yin/ rang dbang med de gzhan dbang can yin te/ dge ba'i bya ba sgrub dus dge ba'i lus/ mi dge ba'i bya ba sgrub dus mi dge ba'i lus zhes/ lus dge mi dge'i gzhan dbang can yin/ ngag yang rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa/ gtam skad cha sna tshogs pa brjod dus

706)re re bzhin 'gyur 'gro ba dang*/ phra ba skad cig gi mi rtag pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'gyur 'gro ba yin/ gcig ma yin te ka kha ga nga 'bru sum cu 'don pa la 'dra mi 'dra sum cur 'gro ba lta bur gcig ma yin du ma yin/ rang dbang med de sems kyi rnam rtog ci 'char nas/ ngag ji ltar brjod 'dod na de ltar brjod pa yin pas ngag sems kyi gzhan dbang can yin/ sems rtag pa ma yin te/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa rnam rtog sna tshogs pa re re bzhin yang 'dra mi 'drar 'gyur bas gcig ma yin du ma yin/ rang dbang med de yul bzang ngan ji mthong na sems de'i rjes su 'gro bas/ sems yul gyi gzhan dbang can yin no/ de dag gis rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang gi tha dad min cing*/ mi rtag du ma gzhan dbang gi tha dad yin no/ da ni mi rtag du ma gzhan dbang gi tha dad de grub bam snyam na mi grub ste/ lus 'di nyid mdun du bzhag ste rang gi shes rab kyis blos rnam par dpyad dgos te/ lus cha tshang 'di la lus zhes brjod la/ lus zer ba'i ming don der/ mgo yar phral/ lag pa gnyis so sor phral/ rkang pa gnyis so sor phral na/ mgo ni lus min/ lag pa gnyis 707)lus min/ rkang pa ni lus min/ khog pa ni lus min/ lus zhes ming btags pa tsam las don la grub pa med par thag chod/ mgo sogs yan lag zer ba yin kyang*/ mgo sogs dum bu bzhi bzhi re 'phang na/ thod pa g.yas g.yon/ 'gram pa g.yas g.yon zer ba las mgo ril por 'dzin pa ldog lag pa dum bu bzhir 'phang bas/ lag mgo 'khrig ma gru mo/ dpung pa zer ba las lag pa zer ba med/ rkang pa rkang mgo rje ngar sum mdo/ brla dang bzhir 'gyur/ khog pa yang phrag g.yas g.yon= dpyi g.yas g.yon so sor 'dzin pas yan lag tu 'dzin pa ldog yan lag rnams so sor dbye bas nying lag ste/ de yang dum bu bzhi bzhi ste 'phang bas nying lag tu 'dzin pa ldog de'i bzhi cha re'ang cha bzhi bzhi ste re 'phang na bzhi cha'i 'dzin pa ldog

de rnams kyang sha dum khrag thig lta bur dum bu dum bur so sor dbye nas sman 'dul ba bzhin byas pa'i de phan chod na bcom zhing gzhig rgyu gzhan med par byed pa la/ gzhig pa'i rdul phran cha med zer/ de theg dman bye mdo rnams kyis don dam par snod bcud rtsom pa'i rgyur yod par 'dod/ gzhig 708)pa'i rdul phran de yang theg chen gyi rigs pa/ gcig gi drug char sbyar ba yi// phra rab 'ang rdul cha drug tu 'gyur// drug po dag gi go gcig na// gong bu yang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas dpyad na/ gzhig pa'i rdul phran cha med gcig la yang*/ shar la blta ba'i cha gcig lho la blta ba'i cha gcig nub la blta ba'i cha gcig byang la blta ba'i cha gcig steng la blta ba'i cha gcig 'og la blta ba'i cha gcig ste cha drug yod la/ cha drug yod pa de so sor phral na gzhig pa'i rdul cha med pa de yang blos gzhal bas cha drug tu 'gyur/ so sor dbye ba'i cha/ re re'ang cha drug tu dbye rgyu yod kyang*/ de dag gi cha re yang drug drug tu phye bas mthar phra zhing phra ba zhig yod kyang*/ cha drug med pa ni mi srid/ yod phyin chad dbyer yod par phyes phyes pas mthar ci'ang med pa'i bar blos dpyad de stong par gtan la dbab pa la/ yul kho rang gi 'dug tshul stong nyid de lta bu'i rang bzhin yin par ngo shes te de dang mthun pa'i blo skyed ba ni/ lus stong pa'o zhes so/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las 709)rten 'byung 'gag med du shar bas na stong pa nyid lus so zhes bya/ stong rten 'byung dbye bsal med pa snang bas stong pa ma spangs/ stong pas snang ba ma spangs/ snang ba stong thog tu spyan ma drangs/ stong pa snang thog tu spyan ma drangs/ snang stong dbyer med yin pas lus las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang lus gzhan ma yin no/ zhes stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyis rig pas gtan la phab pa ni/

mdo lam gyi dbu ma chen po'i lta ba dang mtshungs la 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum thams cad kyi don bsgom pa yin/ de bzhin du ngag 'di sgra rdul yin par theg dman gyi gzhung las gsungs pas/ de yang gcig gi drug char sbyar ba'i rigs pas cha drug tu dbye nas/ mthar rang bzhin bden par grub pa ci'ang med pa'i ngang du gtan la dbab pas ngag stong pa'o/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las rten 'byung 'gag med du shar bas na stong pa nyid ngag go snang stong dbye bsal med pas ngag las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang ngag gzhan ma yin no/ zhes stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi rigs pas/ sems 'di nyid de sngon 710)yan gyi rnam rtog thams cad 'das pa 'gags zin pa mi shi tshar ba lta bu yin pas med/ da phan chad kyi rnam rtog thams cad mi sa thog skyes med pa lta bu ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pas med/ da lta'i rtog pa 'di se gol gcig tu gtogs pa'i yun la cha drug re bzhir phyes pa'i cha re re'i yul las kyang mi 'dug pas med/ se gol gcig gtogs pa'i yun la cha drug cu re bzhi ji ltar bgo snyam na/ me tog 'dab ma srab pa lta bu drug cu re bzhir brtsegs pa khab rnon pos 'bigs na se gol gcig btab pa'i yun la 'bigs 'gro bas/ 'dab ma srab pa khab sno bas rim gyis 'bigs pa las cig char phug pa mi srid pas/ 'dab mar re re 'bugs pa'i yun la dus mtha'i skad cig ma re zer/ sems skad cig ma ma gtogs mi sdod pas sems stong nyid du gtan la dbab pa dang bcas pas sa bcad gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba song ba yin no/ ༈ sa bcad gsum pa thun mong ba byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa la/ dang po byung ba'i yul/ skye sa'i yul 'ong sa'i yul rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs de brtag pa la/ mig gi yul du gyur pa'i gzugs ri ra ba/ brag khang khyim/ gling bzhi 711)ri rab sogs phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/

skyes pa bud med/ rta glang sogs/ nang bcud kyi sems can sogs gzugs su snang ba thams cad dum bu bzhi bzhi rer 'phang nas/ gzhig pa'i rdul phran cha med dang*/ de drug char bsgos pa'i gzhig pa'i rdul phran cha med sogs/ sngar ltar dpyad pas rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid du gtan la dbab/ rna ba'i yul du gyur pa'i sgra snyan mi snyan/ che ba chung ba/ sbom pa phra ba sogs sgra yi rigs rnams sgra rdul yin pas drug char sbyar ba'i rig pas stong nyid du gtan la dbab/ sna yi yul du gyur pa'i dri zhim mi zhim sogs dang*/ lce yi yul du ro kha mngar skyur rtsub sogs dang*/ lus kyi yul gyi reg bya 'jam rtsub sogs rnams kyang gcig la drug char sbyar ba'i rig pas dpyad pas stong nyid du gtan la phab/ yid chos khams zer ba/ phyi yul lnga po gzugs lta bu la/ yid yul du gzugs brnyan dang 'dra ba'i yul zhig yod pa/ dper na gnyid du song ba'i dus kyi rmi lam gyi yul lta bu yod pa de/ yid chos khams yin pas de yang phyi yul ma grub na/ nang gi chos khams yan gar ba grub thabs med 712)pas/ de yang rang bzhin gyis stong par gtan la phab/ phyi yul drug med na/ ma med na bu skye mi shes pa dang 'dra bas sems skye ba med do/ nang dbang po drug ni/ mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ rna ba'i dbang po gro ga'i 'dzer bu gcus pa/ sna yi dbang po zangs ky-i mo khab gshib pa lta bu/ lce yi dbang po zla ba bkas pa lta bu/ lus kyi dbang po bya reg na 'jam gyi lpags pa lta bu ste/ dbang po gzugs can pa lnga ni/ rangs pa rdul phran/ rdul phran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin med par gtan la phab pas ma grub/ yid kyi dbang po ni/ drug po 'das ma thag pa yi/ rnam shes gang yin de yid do/ zhes gsungs pas/ rnam shes tshogs drug po gang rung 'gags pa des phyi ma la de skye ba la phan btags pa'i cha/ dper na mi snga ma zhig sgo nas don song na phyi ma 'gro lo ba la phan btags pa lta bu de tsam la yid dbang zhes btags pa yin pas/

de yang 'das pa 'gags zin pas med/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pas med/ da lta skad cig ma phan chad mi 'dug skad cig gcig po de yang*/ 'das pa la blta ba'i cha gcig ma 'ongs pa 713)la blta ba'i cha gcig da lta ba rang gi cha gcig gi cha gsum gsum re phye ba'i cha dgur 'gyur/ cha re re la'ang gsum gsum du dbye bas/ gcig yod na ni cha gsum yod pas/ de ltar phye phye nas rang bzhin med par gtan la dbab pas nang dbang po drug med na pha med na bu skye mi shes pa bzhin sems skye med do/ 'o na de gnyis kyi bar du skye ba yin nam snyam na/ nyin par snang ba'i rdul dang*/ mtshan gyi mun pa'i rdul gnyis/ yang na mig phye dus snang rdul yin/ mig btsum dus mun rdul 'dzin pas snang mun gyi rdul 'di gnyis po rdul phran re re bzhin/ gcig gi drug char sbyar ba'i rigs pas brtags shing dpyad pas rang bzhin bden par grub pa rdul cha tsam med pas yul stong pa'o/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las rten 'byung 'gag med du shar bas stong nyid yul ltar shar/ snang stong dbyer med yin pas yul las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang yul gzhan ma yin no/ zhes stong 714)nyid bzhi sbyor gyi rigs pas gtan la dbab pa yin/ des byung sa'i yul med par gtan la phab tshar nas/ ༈ da ni byung mkhan gyi blo med par gtan la dbab pa la/ sems ni pho mo ma ning min// mtshan med ma yin rigs brgyud min/ ces gsungs pas/ rten pho dang*/ mo dang*/ ma ning*/ mtshan med sogs gang yang ma grub/ lha dang mi dang lha min te mtho ris gsum/ dmyal ba yi dgas dud 'gro ste ngan song gsum ste 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs su ma grub/ dbyibs zlum po gru bzhi sogs su ma grub/ mdog sngo ser dkar dmar sogs su ma grub/ de rnams grub na gzugs mig gi yul du gyur pas mthong dgos rgyu yin na yang mig gi yul du mthong rgyu med pas/

sems gzugs su grub pa med/ sems la sgra snyan mi snyan sogs su grub yod na rna bas thos dgos rgyu yin pas de med pas sna bas thos rgyu'i sgra med/ sems sgra yis stong*/ sems la dri zhim rtsog med/ sems la sgra snyan mi snyan sogs su grub yod na rna bas thos dgos rgyu yin pas de med pas sna bas thos rgyu'i sgra med/ sems sgra yis stong*/ sems la dri zhim rtsog med/ yod na snas bsnom rgyu yod dgos kyang*/ de med pas sna yi yul gyi dri med pas/ sems 715)dri yis stong*/ sems la ro med/ yod na lce yis myong dgos na/ lce yi yul gyi ro med pas/ sems ro yis stong*/ sems la reg bya med/ de yod na lus kyi reg dgos kyang*/ lus kyis reg rgyu med pas/ sems reg byas stong*/ de dag thams cad kyi yul du med pas sems stong pa'o/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las rten 'byung 'gags med du shar bas stong nyid sems ltar du snang*/ snang stong dbye bsal med pas sems las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong nyid las kyang sems gzhan yin zhes stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi rigs pas gtan la dbab/ de ltar byung sa yul dang*/ byung mkhan blo med par gtan la dbab pas/ dper na mo gsham la bu mo dang po skye ma myong na bar du 'dug sa/ tha ma shi sa rtsad gcod mi dgos kyang thog ma nas med pa/ 'dzin stong gi sems 'di la dang po byung sa zhig bar du gnas sa zhig tha mar 'gro sa zhig yod bsam pa'i rnam rtog de ldog pa'i phyir/ ༈ bar du gnas sa gnas mkhan brtag pa ni/ gnas sa yod sa 'dug sa rnams don gcig ming gi 716)rnam grangs yin/ de'ang phyi yul drug nang dbang po drug bar snang mun gyi rdul dang bcas pa stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi rigs pas gtan la dbab/ ༈ gnas mkhan yod mkhan rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas/ gnas mkhan sems la pho mo ma ning sogs dang*/

'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs dang*/ dbyibs dang kha dog gi gzugs su med/ yod na mig gis mthong dgos pa la mig gis mthong rgyu'i gzugs kyi stong*/ de bzhin du sngar ltar sems la sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med pas yul du bya ba med/ sems kho rang 'das ma 'ongs dang lta dus gsum brtags pas med pa'i stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges pas drangs/ ༈ tha mar 'gro sa yal sa zhig sa rnams don gcig phyi yul drug nang dbang po drug bar snang mun gyi rdul dang bcas pa/ rags pa rdul phran/ rdul phran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin med par gtan la dbab/ ༈ 'gro mkhan sems la gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs med pa'i stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges shes drangs/ de yan chad thun mong ba byung gnas 'gro 717)gsum brtags pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po la ngo bo shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ rang bzhin shes pa'i shes pa gnyis yod pas/ shes pa'i shes pa byung gnas 'gro gsum brtags nas/ 'khrul snang 'di bshig pa yin 'di yang yang gom 'dris byed pa gal che che// 718)

719)༄༅/ dbang po shin tu rtul po la 'go 'dzin gong ltar zhag gcig thun gyi sngon 'gro/ lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal ba/ sems gnad kun slong bcos pa/ bla ma la gsol 'debs/ thun mjug bsngo smon bya tshul bslab nas zhag gcig dngos gzhi sems rtsad bcad pa la/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi kun nas bslangs ste mi dge ba bcu bsgrub pas ngan song du skye ba zhig byas na lus ngag yid gsum gang gtso che brtag pa zhag gcig rgyu 'bras la yid ches pas sbyin pa tshul khrims zhi gnas gsul la bslab ste lha mi thob par byed na gtso gang che zhag gcig byang chub sems kyis phyin drug spyad de sangs rgyas bsgrub na gnad gang che zhag cig rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyis mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub na gal gang che zhag gcig lung gis sems gtso che bar sgrub pa zhag gcig mtshang btsal ba la lus ngag yid gsum ngos bzung ba zhag gcig lus ngag mthong thos rung bas sems mthong thos med pas gcig min tshul zhag gcig 720)lus zhes brtags pa'i gzhi mgo rkang lag khog so sor phye bas lus zhes btags pa'i gzhi ma grub pa zhag gcig mgo sogs dum bzhir 'phang bas gzugs ma grub pa zhag gcig lag mgo sogs dum bur bzhir 'phang bas yan lag ma grub pa zhag gcig sor mo rnams dum bzhir 'phang bas nying lag ma grub pa zhag gcig de yang sha dum khrag thig tu gtor ba zhag gcig de yang sman 'dur ba'i rdul ltar bshig pa zhag gcig de yang nyi zer rdul 'bring po la bzhi bcur 'phang ba'i cha gcig bar gzhig pa'i rdul phran cha med par dpyad pa zhag gcig de la shar lho nub byang steng 'og phyogs drug brtag pa zhag gcig de'i cha re re la cha drug drug phye ba zhag gcig de yang nang gses phye ba rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes lhang gis skyes ma byung bar zhag re re bsgom bcol/ nges shes skye dus de don dam par stong pa nyid ces pa'i yin pas lus stong pa'o zhes byas ba yin ces zhag gcig

dbyibs gzugs i 'dug zhag gcig rigs drug gi gzugs i 'dug zhag gcig gzugs yod na mig gis mthong rgyu i 'dug zhag gcig rna bas thos rgyu'i sgra i 'dug zhag gcig snas tshor ba'i dri i 723)'dug zhag gcig lces myong ba'i ro i 'dug zhag gcig lus kyis reg pa'i reg bya i 'dug zhag gcig sems rnam rtog skad cig gi phreng ba la 'das pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da lta'i skad cig la dus gsum gyi cha dbye ba zhag gcig de nang gses dbye ba rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes ma drang bar du zhag re re bzhin bsgom bcol/ gnas pa'i yul dang*/ gnas mkhan sems/ 'gro ba'i yul dang*/ 'gro mkhan sems bcas brtag dpyad bya lugs byung sa byung mkhan ji lta ba la zhag gcig grangs bgo lugs mang nyung ci dgos slob ma'i nges shes skye lugs la dpyad de mdzad/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams don so sor dum bur bcad de zhag je mang btang ba las khrid dngos zhal rgyun ji lta ba chad lhag med pa dgos lags/ ka) lus 'di rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa zhag gcig chu bo'i rgyun ltar phra ba skad cig gi mi rtag pa zhag gcig lus 'di gcig ma yin rdul phran du ma tshogs pa yin pa zhag gcig rang dbang can min pa dge mi dge'i gzhan dbang can zhag gcig ngag rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa zhag 724)gcig phra ba skad cig gi mi rtag pa zhag gcig du ma yin pa zhag gcig ngag sems kyi gzhan dbang yin pa zhag gcig sems rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa gzhan zhag gcig phra ba skad cig gis mi rtag pa zhag gcig du ma yin pa zhag gcig sems yul gyi gzhan dbang can zhag gcig kha) zhag grangs bcad lugs dper mtshon na/ bzhag rtags zhag gcig go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa g.yi li ma i 'dug blta ba la zhag du dgos snang zer na dus gsum gyi rtog pa i red zhag gcig da lta'i rtog bcas i red zhag gcig brgyal ba sogs kyi rtog med i red zhag gcig

spyod pa la dge sdig 'dor len tshul bzhin mdzad na sgom go chod/ spyod pa chos na sgom nyin mtshan 'dres kyang sgom go mi chod pa zhag gcig 'bras bu la gnas skabs 'bras bu rnam rtog thams cad rang yal rang zhig ma red par ngo bo skyong dgos tshul zhag gcig mar shes drin dran sogs kyis sems can sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyi 727)snying rje sgom dgos tshul zhag gcig mthar thug 'bras bu/ sgom nyin snang mtshan snang chod na rab tshe 'dir grol/ mtshan snang ma chod pa shas che na 'bring bar do/ nyin snang yang res 'ga' ma chod na skye ba phyi ma bsgrod dgos tshul zhag gcig ngo sprod la ngo bo stong pa zhag gcig rang bzhin gsal ba zhag gcig nang gsal thugs rje zung 'jug zhag gcig rnam rtog thams cad phyir gsal thugs rjer shes pa zhag gcig ngo bo rang bzhin nang gsal thugs rje gsum lam gyi chos skur ngo sprad pa zhag gcig rig rtsal/ rnam rtog phyi rol yul dang bcas pa chos sku'i rol par ngo sprad pa zhag gcig dbang thams cad kyi rtsa ba chos dbang sems la bskur ba yin par thag bcad zhag gcig don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro yin pa zhag gcig don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin pa zhag gcig mtshon bya don gyi bla ma yin pa zhag gcig chos nyid don gyi lha yin pa zhag gcig stong nyid snying rjer 'brel ba mkha' 'gro yin pa zhag gcig gnyug ma'i dran pa ye shes 728)chos skyong yin pa zhag gcig dran shes bag yod 'jig rten chos skyong yin pa zhag gcig 'das nyams gyi mkhan po med pa zhag gcig rig pa gcig pu skyangs bas chog pa zhag gcig rig pas thams cad la khyab pa zhag gcig gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba sogs so byang sngags gsum 'dus par thag bcad zhag gcig lus mi g.yo ba chos bdun ri rgyal lta bu zhag gcig dbang po mi g.yo ba zhag gcig rig pa mi g.yo ba zhag gcig rjes nyams kyi skyong tshul la/ rtogs pa ngo bo yin pa zhag gcig

lus nyams bzang ngan zhag gcig ngag nyams bzang ngan zhag gcig sems kyi snang nyams bzang ngan zhag gcig shes nyams la/ bde nyams zhag gcig gsal nyams zhag gcig mi rtog nyams zhag gcig chags sdang rmongs gsum ngan nyams zhag gcig nyams bzang ngan thams cad chu dang rlabs ltar rtsal yin par thag bcad zhag gcig nyams grol ba'i thabs lus kyi bca' bshig zhag gcig ngag gi phaṭa sgra zhag gcig mig gi lta stangs brje ba zhag gcig ngag gi gtam mi smra ba zhag gcig 729)sems kyi sgom blo bor ba zhag gcig bying ba lta stangs bstod pa zhag gcig rgod na phab pa zhag gcig rgyun du ngang skyong dgos tshul/ thun dang thun mtshams phye nas bsgom/ nam zhig nyin snang mtshan snang ma chod bar nyams len sgrub sa la brtson/ skabs skabs su gegs dang gol pa bsal ba'i phyir du dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs grub na mchog ma grub kyang tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung ba la sdom gsum rnam nges/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba la spyod 'jug sngags kyi 'gros shes pa la gsang snying*/ de dag gi lam rim ngal bso skor gsum/ yon tan mdzod/ yid bzhin mdzod sogs mdzod bdun snying tig ya bzhi'i khrid nyams dang*/ klong chen snying thig gi dbang bzhi'i lam rim rnams la slob sbyong dgos tshul dang*/ rgyun du klong snying gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don rab thun bzhi/ tha na thun re ma chag pa/ lo re re bzhin 'bum lnga tshang bar grub na rab/ min kyang 'bum re re ma grub thabs med sogs kyi zhal bsgos mdzad pas ka 730)dag khregs chos kyi khrid re zhig tshar ba yin/ snying nor sprul sku'i gsung gsang ma ldog nas// gang dran chal chol bris pa'i dge ba des// 'khrul pa'i snang ba chal chol zhig nas kyang*// gnyug ma'i ye shes klong du 'gyur bar shog pad+ma ma ṇis so// 731) ༄༅/ lags rin po che/ gong du bsgom pa de ltar/ chos sku snang mtha'/ longs sku spyan gzigs/ sprul sku rta mgrin sogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyang*/

bdag nyid thugs rje chen po la 'dus te/ sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes kyi rtsal las shar ba las/ tshur bsdu na/ rnam pa mang po yong gi med pas/ gnyis med don gyi lha spyan ras gzigs su gsal bas/ tshur rdub pa'i rlung*/ oṃ dang ma yi sgra gdangs/ nang du gnas pa'i rlung ṇi dang pad/ phyir 'byin pa'i rlung*/ me ham̐'u hrīḥyi sgra gdangs su bsgom na/ ye nas dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug gnas gsum sngags kyi sgra gdangs rang byung rang la rdzogs pa yin pas/ de'i don shes par bya ba ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa'am rlung gi bzlas pa la 'bad pas sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas kyi nyams dang*/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i lhag mthong gi rtogs pa'i ye shes 'bar bar bsam pa yin/ de ni rang thugs rje chen por gsal bas rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum sngags su mos pas lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs yin/ lta ba la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ da lta'i sa rdo ri brag gi snang ba thams cad mdog ma ( bsgyur ?) 'gyur/ spu ma brjes par snang ba 'dis 732) lta go chod pas snang ba thugs re chen po'i sku yin te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul du gyur pa dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems ltar snang ba yang*/ don lta ba ye shes chen po'i thog tu bzhag na rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gyi rgyu ba/ rang dag rang yal/ wal po/ rjes med du bral ba'i sems kyi ngo bo la ltos dang*/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad kyang*/ rig pa'i rtsal las shar ba'i rang snang nyag gcig yin pas/ de lta bu'i ye shes gting gsal rig pa rjen la bud pa 'di ngo mtshar che'o/ shes rgyud kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra grags pa thams cad thugs rje chen po'i gsung yin te/ sgra tshig brjod pa dang bral ba'i don lta ba'i ngo bo la ltos dang*/ sgra grags pa thams cad chos nyid kyi rang sgra'am rang grags su 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi rig pa'i rang thog mnyam par bzhag pas sgra sgra grags kyi gsung go chod pa ngo mtshar che'o/

sems dang sems byung gi rtog tshogs thams cad thugs rje chen po'i thugs yin te/ rig pa ye shes zang ma thal byung gi ngang la mnyam par zhog dang*/ rnam rtog thams cad tshugs mi thub par chu la ris mo bris pa bzhin yal ba ye nas grol ba rnam rtog thams cad ngo bo'i thog tu rang grol du 'gyur ba'i/ ye shes kyi rig pa ngo mtshar che'o/ sems 733)kyi ngo bo rang nyid chos nyid don gyi lha yin pa dang*/ chos can rtags kyi lha thugs rje chen po'i sku ltar shar ba gnyis/ gnyis su med de gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i sems kyi gnas lugs la ltos dang*/ blta byed rtogs pa 'di ngo bo yin no snyam pa'i nges shes kyi blo de yang ngo bo'i steng du rang sar grol zhing dmigs gtad dang bcas par bltas pas rig pa'i ngo bo thugs rje chen po mi mthong*/ sgom blo bor nas ma bltas par rang babs su ( lhod ?) kyis ( glod ? ) la bzhag pas rig pa'i ngo bo chos nyid don gyi lha dang mjal/ rnam rtog gis 'di dang 'di'o zhes rtsol bas ma sgrub/ rig pa'i gshis thog tu gnas pas/ shes sgrib rnam rtog rim gyis spangs te 'bras bu rang gnas ye shes mngon du gyur nas sangs rgyas 'grub la/ de yang sngar sangs rgyas ma yin pa/ da sangs rgyas su sgrub pa med do/ sems can gyi rgyud la ye nas gnas pa'i bde gshegs snying po rtog med cir mi dgongs pa rang byung gi ye shes thugs rje chen por mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ rang snang go ma 'gags pa snang ba mtha' yas/ rig pa rang gsal rta mgrin rgyal po/ rnam rtog rang gis rang grol ba gsang ba ye 734)shes/ chos thams cad ye nas rang bzhin gyi ma skyes pa thub pa drug rig pa'i rang bzhin ngag gis 'di'o zhes brjod du med pa sangs rgyas stong*/ phrin las sam rang rtsal rnam rtog lhun gyis rdzogs pa khro chen bzhi ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyang rig pa'i ngo bo las ma grub/

chos thams cad stong nyid du dbyer med pa chos sku/ rten 'brel ma 'gag par rig pa rang gsal longs sku/ sna tshogs rnam rtog gi 'dzin pa chos nyid du grol ba sprul sku ste/ sku gsum yang sems kyi ngo bo las gzhan du med pa'i ye shes kyi rig pa ngo mtshar che'o/ de tsam go na i lo ( du ? ) ji lta ba mi shes lags//
